# ghost/youtube_web

YouTube without an account via m.youtube.com in Chrome: search videos, read a video's title/channel/stats, list a channel's latest uploads.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/youtube_web
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/youtube_web search_videos --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/youtube_web get_video_info --device <serial> --param video_id=<video_id>
ghost skill run ghost/youtube_web list_channel_videos --device <serial> --param handle=<handle>
```

## Actions

- `search_videos`: Search YouTube for lofi hip hop
- `get_video_info`: What is YouTube video dQw4w9WgXcQ?
- `list_channel_videos`: What did Lofi Girl upload recently?
